defects.evidence: The fixing PR split argv on "--" first and looks for mode flags (-h, -V, --self-test, --status) only in the head, because matching them across the whole argv made `with-device d -- tool --version` print its own version and exit 0 without running the command.

The fixing PR made the release signable (cosign bundle, SBOM, provenance) and changed the manifest to `sha256sum ./*` because varve consumes entries with a ./ prefix; the escape release published unsigned digests that its consumer could not ingest.
